why_no_manifest_or_pr: The issue contract requires the original full-source SHA-256. The active evidence validator rejects an ordinary input above 32 MiB and requires each named baseline pin to bind to an actual whole-file descriptor whose file SHA-256 equals the pin. A derived roster, compressed replacement, source note, or omitted descriptor cannot satisfy both constraints without changing or weakening a gate.
engineering_handoff: Extend the evidence format/validator to support reviewed bounded partitioning of oversized original GeoJSON while retaining the exact full-source hash, retrieval identity, ancestry, record coverage, and per-part byte limits. Do not raise the ordinary per-file limit globally, disable validation, or repin this issue to a derived subset.
